status: PROPOSED; source-derived reload quote, no FP20/persistence execution
decision: same-packet ammo companion; no dependency on legacy E1–E5 gifts or unproven shop coverage

policy.trigger: only a decided successful longgun or sidearm_pair loot packet
policy.quantityMeaning: integer inventory units passed to ItemUtil.singleSubmit, not projectile count or a universal magazine conversion
policy.referenceLoad: one full ordinary paid reload per delivered gun, quoted from its actual resolved weapon+mods; empty ordinary magazine and zero pre-paid reserve in an isolated quote view; no gunslinger discount, ghost/reward/extra chamber allowance
policy.normalCostFormula: max(0, ceil((requestedNormalRounds - paidReserve) / ordinaryCapacity)); reference quote uses requestedNormalRounds=ordinaryCapacity and paidReserve=0
policy.liveReloadSemantics: box magazine fill requests ordinaryCapacity; tube requests missing ordinary rounds and consumes persisted reserve before opening more inventory packs; reference quote does not mutate actual saved state
policy.subweaponCost: onLoadGroup -> actual clipCostPerLoad, regardless of sub capacity; onFire -> a separately audited finite group cost fireCost*groupCapacity; unknown consume modes reject the quote
policy.deliveredSlots: longgun packet: only its primary slot and its installed/inherent subweapon; pair packet: each of its two actual pistol slots, no enemy primary or primary subweapon
policy.aggregation: sum required quantities by exact inventory ammo name across selected delivered slots; do not deduplicate by taking max or by name presence
policy.materialPacket: consumables=[]; no ammo for none/miss/quota_exhausted either
policy.freeze: freeze ammo quote and contributions in same DECIDED_HIT record as weapon snapshots; no re-quote, second roll, or ammo-only retry after save/load
policy.admission: one RewardStashService transaction over packet.items.concat(packet.consumables), preferInventory=false; same owner/source/operation
policy.quotaAccounting: items remain at most two weapon instances; consumables are same packet numeric-value items, never a third gun, extra reward package, or mod-material reward; total supply is sum of quotes for at most six successful packages
policy.economicFreeze: access structure approved as design; no final expected amount, probability, currency valuation or fixed chapter ammo yield is asserted

coverage.reason: Ammo accompanies only the already-decided successful probabilistic weapon packet, under the preserved Round1 contract.
